div.head: AN EXPOSITION Of the PROPHESY of HOSEA.
VERS. 1.

epigraph.q: Set the Trumpet to thy mouth: he ſhall come as an Eagle againſt the Houſe of the LORD: becauſe they have tranſgreſſed my Covenant, and treſpaſſed againſt my Law.

div.p: THE Prophet ſtill continues the Denunciation of Judgment againſt Iſrael, with the Declaration and Aggravation of their ſins.

epigraph.q: They have ſet up Kings, but not by me: they have made Princes, and I knew it not.

div.head: They ſet up Kings,Expoſ. 1. but not by me
div.p: Firſt,Ieroboams ſin. Becauſe Jeroboam did not ſeek God.
Thirdly, Jeroboam had not right ends in taking the Kingdom.

epigraph.q: Becauſe Ephraim hath made many Altars to ſin, Altars ſhall be unto him to ſin.

div.head: And then, Ephraim hath made many Altars to ſin.
div.p:
God ſtill remembers the firſt and the chief Actors in ſin
[Ephraim] he ſpeaks to the ten Tribes, and yet only names Ephraim, Obſ. 1. becauſe the Governors were of that Tribe.

div.head: VERS. 1.

epigraph.q: Rejoyce not, O Iſrael for joy as other people; for thou haſt gone a whoring from thy God, thou haſt loved a reward upon every corn-flour.

div.p: HERE begins another Sermon of the Prophets.Gualt.

div.head: VERS. 1.

epigraph.q: Iſrael is an empty Vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himſelf: according to the multitude of his fruit, he hath encreaſed the Altars: according to the goodneſs of his Land, they have made goodly Images.

div.p: HERE Gualter makes the beginning of Hoſea's ſeventh Sermon.

div.head: VER. 15.

epigraph.q: So ſhall Bethel do unto you, becauſe of your great wickedneſs.

div.p: SO ſhall Bethel.] What ſhall Bethel riſe up againſt the reſt of the ten Tribes, and come and deſtroy Mother and Children together? That's not the meaning.
